messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick thread for Doorstep Delight pilot 60 4 5  5    : small, manager-triggered $40 gift + handwritten note delivered to home addresses. Goal: test logistics and privacy by end of month. Need sign-off on fields + payout path.
Tom (Payroll): Main constraints: we can do prepaid card for <$50 but need recipient_email and country. For home deliveries we need recipient postal address; sensitive data handling required.
Bea (Finance): Budget code will be RECOG-DOOR-2026. We need consolidated CSV: name,email,address_line1,city,state,postal,country,amount_usd,budget_code,manager_approver.
Cal (Eng): UX idea: two opt-ins on form  public_shoutout (yes/no) and mailing_consent (yes/no). Mail consent must be explicit.
Aisha (People Ops): Agreed  mailing_consent required. We'll store addresses in a locked Airtable view with ops-only access.
Jen (Office Ops): Logistics: vendor lead time 5 business days for physical notes + items. For pilot we'll limit to local US only to simplify.
Tom (Payroll): Good call on US-only. Also warn managers about frequency caps; if aggregated >$600 tax flag applies.
Bea (Finance): We'll run weekly reconciliation and validate GL mapping. Ops please include manager_email for approvals.
Aisha (People Ops): Pilot plan: 25 recipients over 3 weeks, managers nominate via form, ops does a weekly dedupe, payroll runs prepaid cards on Fridays.
notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Doorstep Delight pilot kickoff Mon" at 9:00 AM PT.
Cal (Eng): I'll help wire up the short form and a locked view.
Jen (Office Ops): I'll coordinate packaging and vendor pick-up.
